items.text: Using SST, loosen the body side hinge bolts.

content.description: Illustration showing the adjustment of the door lock striker using a screwdriver and wrench

items.title: ADJUST DOOR LOCK STRIKER
steps: (a) Check that the door fit and door lock linkages are adjusted correctly.
(b) Adjust the striker by loosening the striker mounting screws.
